Maya Chen: Heads-up — BigCorp is requesting RLHF-style evals as part of their onboarding benchmarks. They want a canary requirement: model only GA for them after passing their RLHF safety/quality checks. Can we define an exception flow?
Liam O'Connor: Do they expect us to run their reward model on our infra or will they provide harness + labels?
Maya Chen: They’ll supply a reward model and a small labeled holdout. Privacy OK but they insist the run happens on Dedicated.
Raj Patel: This adds infra/security work beyond perf/tox checks. Suggest flow: 1) standard bench (latency, throughput, tox), 2) tenant-isolated RLHF harness run, 3) manual QA if harness flags regressions, 4) pin entry until periodic re-eval.
Sophia Varela: RLHF runs can be costly/time-consuming. We need timeboxes and SLOs so onboarding doesn't block other customers. What thresholds are acceptable?
Maya Chen: Customer expects pass within 2 weeks or they want rollback/opt-out. Also require model pinned for 90 days post-GA.
Liam O'Connor: Draft gated criteria:
```
- Functional: no major regression on core intents (>99% intent coverage)
- Quality: client reward-model delta <= 0.03 vs their baseline (higher is better)
- Safety: automated toxicity filters + manual audit of top 100 failures
- Performance: 95th pct latency within Dedicated SLO (or customer pays for burst)
- Cost: RLHF run < N GPU-hours (TBD)
```
Raj Patel: Ops constraints: run in tenant-isolated namespace, scrub volumes/logs, only return aggregated metrics, and do not persist their reward model long-term.
Sophia Varela: Product metadata asks: add catalog fields `rlhf_required`, `rlhf_pass_ts`, `pinned_until`, `rlhf_owner` for Console & billing.
Maya Chen: Also allow `provisional-GA` for non-critical routes for up to 14 days if harness is flaky while we troubleshoot.
Liam O'Connor: Owners: infra + eng-ml pair. Raj, can you estimate infra changes (isolation + ephemeral GPU quota)?
Raj Patel: Estimate: 2 days design, ~1 week to provision namespaces/quotas/scrub pipeline, +3 eng-days for integration tests.
Sophia Varela: I’ll model chargeback pricing for customer-covered RLHF runs and share EOD Thu.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Raj: infra design + estimate doc (due Tue)
- Liam: define RLHF pass spec (metrics, sample size) (due Wed)
- Sophia: pricing/chargeback (due Thu EOD)
- Maya: draft onboarding playbook and metadata fields (due Fri)
infra-bot: CI: #rlhf-harness-infra build passed — 1 job, 0 failures (:white_check_mark:)
Liam O'Connor: Add explicit rollback clause to onboarding contract.
Maya Chen: Noted. I’ll loop in legal and AE after next sync.
Sophia Varela: Can someone add an optional gate `RLHF_OVERRIDE` to the onboarding checklist? A small doc PR would be ideal.
Raj Patel: I’ll open a draft infra PR today and tag reviewers.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to align owners. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
